initialization.note: ImageNet-only. A derived initialization copy retains only the identical classification/detection backbone blocks 0..8. It excludes classifier block 9 because it is not detection SPPF block 9, despite some matching BN names. The official detector architecture and loader stay unchanged. Source/derived checkpoint SHAs must be verified before training.

selection.note: Official periodic checkpoint filenames are zero-based. Epochs are a declared initial budget, not a convergence claim. Freeze TRAIN/VAL decisions before TEST.

protocol_notes: Official YOLO26m OBB26 architecture and native trainer/assigner/loss/predictor are retained.
Retain pinned official YOLO training augmentations and optimizer auto rule. This is a per-method training-recipe comparison, not an equal-augmentation or equal-budget causal ablation.
100 epochs and batch 2/nbs 4 are preparation settings. Warmup accumulation varies under the official trainer. Do not claim every update has effective batch 4.

pretrained=true preserves the explicitly loaded ImageNet model in native train(). It must not be false, which would discard that initialization. No weight is downloaded by preparation/check commands. Formal initialization is blocked until its SHA is recorded.
GPU physical 2/3 are intended, but mapping, memory and runtime must be checked before any later authorized run.
